messages:
Maya: Quick sync — NimbusCloud confirmed a co-hosted 30min session at CloudConnect (track B). Need to lock: final speaker list, demo run order, swag counts and shipping deadlines. Who can own what?

Jon: I can lead the demo. Proposed flow: 5m intros, 12m joint live demo (Redwood + Nimbus use-case), 8m deep-dive Q&A, 5m wrap. Fallback = recorded demo + live Q&A if AV flaps.

Priya: Re swag/shipping: recommend 2 shipping windows — booth pre-load (arrives 3 days before) and overflow courier. Customs for EU takes ~10 business days. Target ship date to Redwood ops: 2026-05-12. Need final SKU list by 2026-05-04.

Kai: AV/infra notes: we need an isolated test VPN into Nimbus staging by 2026-05-05 to rehearse. For live demo we should bring a small on-prem box (1 RU) as fallback, plus HDMI+USB-C dongles. Also specify model variant and token limits ahead of time. Latency SLO for demo: <200ms median.

Maya: Speakers so far: Jon (Redwood demo owner), Elena (Nimbus PM), and a short product intro from me. Elena — can you share names/bios/headshots by EOD Thu? I’ll draft co-email for promotion. @Elena

Jon: Demo checklist snippet for rehearsals (local run):
```
# run demo locally
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/demo:latest 
# sets model to redwood-dedicated-v2, port 8080 
```
Will add a canned video (3m) as backup.

Kai: For model config, recommend quantized fp16 for demo stability. Also plan an automatic fallback to a smaller compatible model if memory spikes. I can add routing policy in the test env.

Priya: Swag counts suggestion: 100 tees (S-XL mix), 300 stickers, 150 notebooks, 50 premium partner pins. Shipping: DHL for US, FedEx for EU to avoid held customs. Need declared values for HS codes — I’ll compile.

SwagBot: Shipping label created: 1Z999AA10123456784 (pre-label for booth crate). ETA at venue: 2026-05-18.

Maya: Awesome. Action items:
- Jon: finalize demo script + backup video (due 2026-05-06)
- Kai: confirm VPN access + fallback box spec (due 2026-05-05)
- Priya: final SKU + customs HS codes (due 2026-05-04)
- Maya: co-email draft + promo assets (due 2026-05-06)
We’ll do a full dry-run 2026-05-15 10am PT. Sound good? :thumbsup:

Jon: Sounds good. I’ll ping when demo script is up.

Kai: Confirmed for VPN test on 2026-05-05.

Priya: Will upload final swag spreadsheet to the shared drive by 2026-05-03.

Maya: Thanks team — locking calendar invite for 2026-05-15 DR. I’ll follow up on speaker bios. :tada:
